svg.title: Windows 365 licensing for Enterprise and Flex
svg.desc: Every Enterprise and Flex user needs Windows Enterprise, Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Entra ID P1 licenses. In Enterprise, the user also has a Windows 365 license and uses their Cloud PC. In Flex, licenses are pooled for the tenant and apply to Dedicated and Shared mode. Dedicated mode gives up to three Cloud PCs per license, each for one user, with one active session per license. Shared mode gives one Cloud PC per license, shared by a group, with one active session per license. Users must be in the Microsoft Entra security group named in the provisioning policy.
svg.text: Every user needs these three licenses (Enterprise and Flex)
Windows 365 Enterprise: one more license per user
Windows 365 Flex: licenses are pooled for the tenant
Up to 3 Cloud PCs per license
Each Cloud PC for one user
Shared by a group of users
Named in the provisioning policy. Users must be in it.
